richiami.difetto: For certain vehicles manufactured within a specific period it is possible that the gas generator housing may be damaged if a side airbag is deployed. richiami.difetto: The wiring loom from the ignition coil to the ECU may chafe on a cylinder head bolt. This could eventually result in an electrical short circuit and/or fire risk.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of brackets and cable ties to secure the wiring loom clear of the cylinder head bolt in question.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE SHORT CIRCUIT/FIRE RISK

richiami.difetto: The handbrake cable may chafe on the fuel filler pipe causing perforation of the pipe and leakage of fuel.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for repositioning and securing of the handbrake cable to ensure adequate clearance between the cable and the filler pipe. At the same time any filler pipes found to be perforated will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: LEAKAGE FROM FUEL FILLER PIPE.

richiami.difetto: The steel brake pipe from the master cylinder to the ABS valve block may chafe on the air cleaner hose. This could result in failure of the pipe with loss of braking on one circuit.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles shorten and re-route the air cleaner hose to avoid possible contact with the brake pipe. Where chafing has taken place the brake pipe will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE BRAKE PIPE CHAFING ON CERTAIN MODELS

richiami.difetto: The anti-lock brake electronic control unit may malfunction due to receiving a reversed polarity feed through its earthing system which shares a common earth point with other electrical systems on the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and alter the wiring system to provide a separate earthing point for the ABS system.
richiami.titolo: ABS WIRING MODIFICATION
